name: Kuzhi Paniyaram
steps: Rinse rice and urad separately. Soak rice in part of the water, and urad with fenugreek in another portion, until soft.
Grind urad fluffy and rice slightly grainy with only enough measured water. Mix, cover and ferment in a warm place until airy and gently risen.
Heat a little oil; crackle mustard seeds and cook onion, chilli and curry leaves until onion softens. Cool slightly and fold into the batter with salt.
Oil the hollows of a paniyaram pan and fill each mostly full. Cover and cook on medium-low heat until bottoms are golden.
Turn each ball and cook the other side until crisp outside and fluffy inside. Serve hot with coconut chutney.
tips: The batter needs real fermentation for light centres; a heavy unfermented batter makes dense paniyaram.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
